scope: Proportion-corrected procedural paired VACE dataset for bimanual flower contact
summary: The corrected dataset retains exact phase/contact trajectories with smaller flowers and is usable for a trainability smoke test, but remains synthetic proxy supervision.
evidence: All 12 training and 4 validation clips contain 17 frames at 448x256 and 8 FPS.
All four declared causal contact metrics are exactly 0 pixels for every clip.
lessons: Hand-compatible object proportions are a prerequisite even for a narrow training smoke test.
limitations: The dataset has only 12 short training clips and contains no real robot flower footage, force, or deformation.
next_actions: Reproduce the dataset on the GPU host and use it only for a bounded adapter smoke test.
